# Official FygoOS SDK

Vendored unmodified ESM distribution of `@trimjs/web-app@0.5.0`, downloaded from the npm registry. The upstream README declares MIT licensing (retained in UPSTREAM-README.md); package.json does not include a license field.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@trimjs/web-app/-/web-app-0.5.0.tgz

SHA-256 of `web-app-0.5.0.js`: `198cb570fd43ae45be0a125eef82de8edbe5cff6df73d0139a48a9c35a8f3dec`.

Only platform configuration and supported language-change events are used. No file, authentication, token or device-management APIs are called. SDK updates require review and updating the checksum test.
